correctness.rationale: The 36 windows are exactly the distinct overlap arcs. A three-letter overlap using all symbols admits three continuations; one missing symbol forces the continuation in either direction. From abc with a,b,c distinct, the three appended symbols a,b,c lead after 1,2,3 arcs to bca,cba,cab. The 18 forced paths exhaust all 36 arcs (six paths of each length, disjoint by their unique predecessors). This gives the bidirected triangular prism. Its product Laplacian has spectrum 0,2,3,3,5,5; hence 75 spanning trees and 75 in-arborescences at the normalized root. BEST with one fixed first edge contributes (2!)^6, giving 4,800. The unique window 0120 fixes the rotation without extra factors. Independently I enumerated all unused-window extensions on the original 24-vertex overlap graph, visiting 102,428 search nodes. I obtained 4,800 distinct length-36 cycles with all the right windows, and applied each group element using the least lexicographic rotation, not the frozen canonicalization. Exactly the identity and the three transpositions had nonzero fixed counts (4800 and 40 each); all six reversing operations and both 3-cycles fixed none. Explicit orbit sets gave 40 of size 3 and 780 of size 6 under S3, and 20 of size 6 and 390 of size 12 with reversal. This independently verifies the group census including the absence of relabeled reversals.
residual_risks: This is an exact enumeration at one alphabet size and order, not a formula at larger orders.

evidence: The onto-functions and required-characters theorems cover existence, not enumeration or symmetry. The repeated-letter theorem is about a broader language than the ternary surjective one.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Existence for the target or a superset does not establish a group-action count. BEST counts normalized rooted Euler tours, not fixed points of the action on those tours.

evidence: The companion explicitly does not identify symbol relabelings or reversal. Its 4,800 and the existence theorems give no transposition or reversal fixed-point data.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Burnside requires fixed-point counts beyond total size; the fact that a set has 4,800 elements does not determine its orbit partition or imply reversal acts freely even up to relabeling. Shared count and priority are separate; the same-day date supplies no order.

value.rationale: The additional contribution is a complete intrinsic classification at the first nontrivial ternary surjective order under the natural ambiguities of label choice and orientation. In particular it decides chirality even after relabeling and localizes all nontrivial stabilizers to transpositions. Those properties are useful for choosing distinct representatives and are not routine numerical consequences of the shared rotation count.
